chapter.title: Database System
chapter.para: &project:name; uses a SQLite database for persistent storage of user data, admin levels, bans, XP saves, and other server state. By default the database file is xmod.db, configurable via .

The database is stored in the mod directory (e.g. ~/.etwolf/xmod/xmod.db on &linux:name;). SQLite handles all data persistence automatically. Manual editing of the database is not required for normal operation — use the admin commands instead.
Legacy text-based .db files (level.db, user.db, map.db) from older versions can be migrated to the SQLite database using the !dbload migrate command.

listitem.para: The primary database storing all persistent data: admin levels, user records, bans, XP saves, mute states, and map data. Data maintenance should be done with the appropriate Admin System commands (!setlevel, !ban, !levadd, etc.).
